description: This file defines a Java class 'SavingsTransactionData' that models data related to savings transactions in the context of integration tests for the Apache Fineract project. The class includes fields for transaction details, getter methods, and a method to generate a JSON representation of the transaction data.

classes.name: SavingsTransactionData
classes.description: A data model class used for representing savings transaction details in integration tests, with builder pattern support and JSON serialization.

methods.name: getJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing the savings transaction data, with default values for null fields.
